theorem search_attrs_granted (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (se : SearchEvent) (es : Slice Entry)
    (rs : alloc.vec.Vec EntryReduced) (r : EntryReduced) (x : Ava)
    (h : access.search_filter_entry_attributes ctl se es = ok (.Ok rs))
    (hr : r ∈ rs.val) (hx : x ∈ r.attrs.val) :
    ∃ e ∈ es.val, e.uuid = r.uuid ∧ x ∈ e.attrs.val ∧ SearchGrants ctl se.ident e (nats x.attr.val) := by
  sorry

spec.name: nats
spec.code:
/-- A byte string as numbers. -/
def nats (v : List U8) : List Nat := v.map (·.val)

spec.name: SearchGrants
spec.code:
/-- Some search profile that applies grants attribute `a` on `e`, or `a` is one
of the fixed attributes. -/
def SearchGrants (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (i : Identity) (e : Entry) (a : List Nat) : Prop :=
  (∃ acs ∈ ctl.acps_search.val, a ∈ names acs.attrs.val ∧ Applies i acs.acp e) ∨ a ∈ fixedSearchAttrs

spec.name: Applies
names
spec.code:
/-- Attribute or class names. -/
def names (v : List (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) : List (List Nat) := v.map (fun x => nats x.val)

spec.name: fixedSearchAttrs
spec.code:
/-- What the OAuth2, application and sync-account modules may release, without
a profile. -/
def fixedSearchAttrs : List (List Nat) :=
  ["class", "displayname", "uuid", "name", "oauth2_rs_origin_landing", "image", "linked_group",
   "sync_credential_portal"].map lit

lean.name: access.search_filter_entry_attributes
lean.code:
/-- [kanidm_kernel::access::search_filter_entry_attributes]:
    Source: 'ports/kanidm/kernel/src/access.rs', lines 155:0-198:1
    Visibility: public -/
def access.search_filter_entry_attributes
  (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (se : SearchEvent) (entries : Slice Entry) :
  Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec EntryReduced) OperationError)
  := do
  match se.ident.origin with
  | IdentType.User _ =>
    let (b, modify_related_acp) ←
      if se.effective_access_check
      then
        do
        let modify_related_acp1 ← access.modify_related_acp ctl se.ident
        ok (true, modify_related_acp1)
      else ok (false, alloc.vec.Vec.new profiles.AccessControlModifyResolved)
    let delete_related_acp ←
      if b
      then access.delete_related_acp ctl se.ident
      else ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new profiles.AccessControlDeleteResolved)
    let (o, attrs) ←
      match se.attrs with
      | none => ok (none, none)
      | some _ => ok (se.attrs, se.attrs)
    let search_related_acp ← access.search_related_acp ctl se.ident attrs
    let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref search_related_acp
    let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref modify_related_acp
    let s2 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref delete_related_acp
    let v ←
      access.reduce_entries_loop ctl
        { se with attrs := o, effective_access_check := b } s s1 s2 entries
    ok (core.result.Result.Ok v)
  | IdentType.Synch _ =>
    ok (core.result.Result.Err OperationError.InvalidState)
  | IdentType.Internal _ =>
    ok (core.result.Result.Err OperationError.InvalidState)
